scope: Sequential one-GPU passes with actual scripted mouse input; no simultaneous GPU contention, frame interpolation or playback acceleration. Native-render FPS is measured on the Mac client and model time on the RTX 5090. Mobile checks emulate a 390px viewport, not a physical-phone performance benchmark.

summary.scope: Observed GPU outputs actually painted during this recording. Native render FPS is a separate client measure, not diffusion throughput. Model median uses history=4 only.
